name: Archelos, Lagoon Mystic
oracle_text:
As long as Archelos is tapped, other permanents enter tapped.
As long as Archelos is untapped, other permanents enter untapped.
blocked_sentences: As long as Archelos is untapped, other permanents enter untapped.

needs.what: a static effect filtered by `affects` (here every permanent, `exclude_self`, any controller) and switched by a static `condition` (this permanent untapped), that makes matching permanents enter the battlefield untapped however they arrive: it overrides a card's own printed self_enters_tapped replacement, another permanent's board `enters_tapped` static, and an effect that puts a permanent onto the battlefield tapped (fetches, ramp spells, tokens created tapped and attacking)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `enters_tapped` static only ever sets tapped to true, so it expresses the first line (with a self-tapped condition and `exclude_self`) but nothing in static_effects sets entering permanents back to untapped or suppresses self_enters_tapped and `tapped: true` on put_onto_battlefield/create_token. Same capability as horizon_explorer's gap. Note the template's starting_point wrongly gives Archelos a `self_enters_tapped` replacement; Archelos itself enters normally
